# Hedge 3
Trim hedges and potted plants into marvelous new shapes with any old knife. Not applicable to plastic plants.
## Using it 1. Hold a sharp item.\n2. Click a potted plant and stand still for a moment while you trim it.
Cosmetic. Without the chip the same click stashes the item inside the plant as usual.
## Notes The new shape is random.\nMoving cancels the trim.
